title: Odile and the Vector
author: Beatrix Thackeray
blurb: Yara Amberdale, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
